summary: P1 Sprint testing for Sentinel Edge. All P1 features verified: enriched /api/tickers, /api/correlation, Mock Mode toggle, Market Breadth panel, TIGHTEN_TRAILING_STOP Decision enum. 39 new P1 backend tests + 40 regression tests all pass (79/79 total). All Frontend features working.

minor.issue: Prometheus metrics endpoint is at root path (no /api prefix) — K8s ingress routes it to frontend HTML in preview environment. Metrics not accessible via public URL. This is a deployment concern; internal scraping may work differently.

atr is 0.57 for SPY but confidence is 0.0 because confidence = min(|signal_strength|/10, 1) and signal_strength is 0.0 (markets closed). ATR and confidence are technically correct but look inconsistent to users when ATR > 0 but confidence = 0.0.

issues: Market Breadth shows '0 Neutral' in live mode even with 4 active tickers. This is by design (breadth only tracks BUY/STOP_BUYING events), but UX is confusing since the breadth bar looks empty when markets are closed. Consider showing 'N/A — awaiting signals' instead of '0 Neutral'.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add last_decision and confidence fields to TickerData TypeScript interface in types/index.ts — currently missing (backend returns them, frontend uses them via 'any' cast, no runtime error but type safety gap)
OPTIONAL: Add data-testid='ticker-card' to root element in TickerCard.tsx for better testability
OPTIONAL: Consider UX improvement for Market Breadth in live mode when no signals recorded — display 'No signals in window' instead of '0 Neutral'
critical_code_review_comments: types/index.ts TickerData interface is missing last_decision?: string and confidence?: number — these are returned by /api/tickers and used in TradingOverview.tsx but not typed. Not a runtime error but a TypeScript type safety gap.
TickerCard.tsx has symbol-scoped data-testid attrs ({symbol}-config-button, {symbol}-toggle-button) but no root data-testid='ticker-card' — makes cross-card queries hard in tests.

/metrics Prometheus endpoint is at root path, not /api/metrics — will not route through K8s ingress to backend in production. If Prometheus scraping requires the public URL it won't work. Recommend moving to /api/metrics or documenting internal-only scraping.

success_rate.backend: 100% (39/39 P1 tests pass, 40/40 regression tests pass)

mocked_apis: Mock Mode is a FRONTEND-ONLY feature. When mockMode=true in Zustand store, TradingOverview calls generateMockTickerList() instead of api.getTickers(). All confirmed MOCKED correctly.
seed_data_creation: None — test used add/remove of TEST_REMOVEME ticker which was cleaned up
context_for_next_testing_agent: P1 sprint fully tested. Backend: 79/79 tests pass total (39 new in test_p1_features.py + 40 regression in test_sentinel_edge.py). Old test had outdated 'symbol in tickers' check that was fixed (now checks by .symbol key). BrokerHealth.tsx and PnLTracking.tsx now have data-testid='broker-health' and 'pnl-tracking' root attributes added. Main known limitation: Prometheus /metrics endpoint inaccessible via public URL (K8s routing issue). All P1 features confirmed working: enriched tickers, correlation endpoint, mock mode toggle, market breadth, TIGHTEN_TRAILING_STOP Decision enum.
